title: competition
summary: A personal collection of notebooks for the 2024 Signate Cup data science competition, including a GANs notebook that builds synthetic tabular training data. It instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata object, fits it on the training dataframe, and evaluates the result with SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic functions.
